task_world.public_context: The UI helps with grocery_dinner_case_604 through interactive planning, constraint validation, staged action, committed action when applicable, status refresh, and final recap.

difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return case-specific state, evidence, candidates, or status objects; write tools return success/error wrappers plus operation, saved-state, submission, hold, confirmation, or audit/readback objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: No explicit decoy tools are declared in this task JSON; noise pressure comes from invalid candidates, blocked choices, stale or secondary evidence in tool outputs, and the need to separate staged work from committed state.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine safe initial review, non-mutating comparison or validation, staged or scoped action, fresh readback after mutation, preservation of rejected alternatives, cross-turn continuity, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: conflicting source arbitration
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must keep authoritative case state separate from secondary, stale, advisory, or conflicting evidence.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: After any write-like action, the UI must refresh authoritative status before presenting completion.

turns.prompt: I am cooking dinner for grocery_dinner_case_604 and one guest has a nut allergy. Build a grocery planner that shows the recipe needs, pantry items, store stock, allergy constraints, coupons, and an empty pickup state. Do not reserve pickup yet.
Add a substitution matrix for each ingredient category. I want it to flag unavailable coupon items and anything unsafe for the allergy, even if it looks cheaper or more convenient.
Create a validated cart for pickup using safe available items and pantry-aware choices. Keep unsafe or unavailable alternatives visible with the reason they were rejected, but do not reserve yet.
Reserve a pickup window only if the current cart validation still passes. Then refresh pickup status so I can see whether the store accepted the cart.
Create a final dinner shopping packet with selected items, rejected substitutions, allergy notes, coupon caveats, pantry items skipped, pickup status, and any remaining in-store checks.
